title: Branch Closing
one_paragraph_synopsis: The Scranton branch faces closure, leading to reactions of disbelief, planning to confront management, and discussions about future job prospects. Jan announces the closure of Scranton, but later reveals Stamford will be absorbed instead. Characters consider their futures, with some planning to move or retire, and others contemplating new opportunities. The episode ends with characters reacting to the confirmed closure and contemplating their next steps.

main_threads.thread: The announcement and reactions to the Scranton branch closure
